title: Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand Reach Syed Modi International Quarterfinals
indian_angle: India's top women's doubles pair advanced to the quarterfinals of a home international tournament.
summary: Defending champions Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured their spot in the quarterfinals of the Syed Modi International by defeating compatriots Shreya Balaji and Pranavi Natarajan in straight games.

title: Tanvi Stretched, Anmol Eases Through at Syed Modi India International
indian_angle: Indian shuttlers Tanvi and Anmol continue their campaigns at the home international tournament, with mixed challenges in their recent matches.
summary: At the Syed Modi India International, Tanvi faced a tough challenge from Puspitasari but advanced, while Anmol comfortably defeated Ashmita to progress in their respective categories.

title: India Awarded Hosting Rights for 2028 Thomas & Uber Cup Finals in New Delhi
indian_angle: This marks a significant achievement for Indian badminton, bringing one of the sport's most prestigious team championships to home soil.
summary: New Delhi has been confirmed as the host city for the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals, a major coup for Indian badminton, following the BWF's announcement.

title: BAI Releases Selection Criteria for 2027 Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships
indian_angle: Indian players aspiring to represent the nation at the prestigious continental mixed team event now have clear guidelines for selection.
summary: Badminton Association of India has announced the selection criteria for the national team participating in the Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships 2027, outlining the pathway for players to earn their spot.

title: 5th Mini National Badminton Championships Venue Changed to Raipur
indian_angle: This update is crucial for young Indian shuttlers and their families planning to participate in the ongoing national championships.
summary: The venue for the Yonex-Sunrise 5th Mini National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled from November 24th to 27th, has been changed to Raipur, as per a recent BAI circular.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships Set for Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: India's top senior shuttlers will compete for national honors at this premier domestic tournament in Bhubaneswar.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced that the 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th.
